earnPoints.question: How do I earn points?
earnPoints.answer: You earn 1 point for every RM1 spent. Sign-up bonuses and promotions may add extra points.

redeemPoints.question: How do I use points at checkout?
redeemPoints.answer: On the bag page, enter the number of points to apply before checkout. Points reduce your order total.

returns.question: How do returns and exchanges work?
returns.answer: Contact support within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused with original tags attached.

payment.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards via Stripe. More local methods may be added later.

shippingAddress.question: How do I change my shipping address?
shippingAddress.answer: Update your address at checkout before placing an order. For an existing order, contact support as soon as possible.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.body: This app lets you shop for shoes right from your phone. We'll show you the important buttons — you can skip any time.

shop.title: Finding shoes
shop.body: Tap a shoe to open it, choose a size, then add it to your bag.
